name: Warstein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, black and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the top with the city arms of Warstein (a black cross on white beside red figures).
history: Municipal flag of Warstein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Warstein arms — cross and red figures
